Get P. LEAGUE+ Player Season Stats

Source: R/pleague.R
pleague_stat_player.Rd

Player season averages and totals of one season and stage: shooting, rebounds, assists and fouls.

Endpoint: GET https://pleagueofficial.com/stat-player/{season slug}/{stage_sn}

Usage

pleague_stat_player(season, stage_sn)

Arguments

season

Required. Season END year (2025 = the site's slug '2024-25'). The slug is <season - 1>-<yy> (yy: the last two digits of season). The first season is 2020-21 (season=2021); earlier slugs redirect.

stage_sn

Required. Stage select value of the player table: 2 = regular season, 3 = playoffs, 4 = finals.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Player season averages and totals of one season and stage: shooting, rebounds, assists and fouls. An empty valid answer is a zero-row tibble with these columns, in this order (sdv-py pleague_stat_player):

col_nametypedescription
seasonintegerSeason END year (2025 = the site's slug '2024-25'): the first year of the slug plus one.
season_slugcharacterThe site's season slug as printed: the START year, then the END year's last two digits ('2024-25').
stage_snintegerStage select value: 2 = regular season, 3 = playoffs, 4 = finals (echo of the request, checked against the page's selected option).
stagecharacterStage slug: pre-season ((Chinese text), exhibition games before the season), regular-season ((Chinese text)), playoffs ((Chinese text)) or finals ((Chinese text), the championship series).
player_page_idcharacterThe 8-character page id of /player/{id} (e.g. '1JbPozLB'). The box random_id on 2022-23+ rows; NOT the box player_id.
name_zhcharacterPlayer name as printed (Traditional Chinese, or a transliteration for foreign players).
jerseycharacterShirt number as a string (the player's number in the latest game).
team_zhcharacterTeam name in Traditional Chinese as the page prints it (a traded player shows the current team).
gamesintegerGames played ((Chinese text)).
minutes_avgcharacterMinutes per game 'mm:ss' ((Chinese text)).
minutes_totalcharacterTotal minutes 'mmm:ss' ((Chinese text)).
fg2_made_avgdoublePer-game average of 2-point makes ((Chinese text)).
fg2_made_totalintegerSeason total of 2-point makes ((Chinese text)).
fg2_att_avgdoublePer-game average of 2-point attempts ((Chinese text)).
fg2_att_totalintegerSeason total of 2-point attempts ((Chinese text)).
fg3_made_avgdoublePer-game average of 3-point makes ((Chinese text)).
fg3_made_totalintegerSeason total of 3-point makes ((Chinese text)).
fg3_att_avgdoublePer-game average of 3-point attempts ((Chinese text)).
fg3_att_totalintegerSeason total of 3-point attempts ((Chinese text)).
ft_made_avgdoublePer-game average of free-throw makes ((Chinese text)).
ft_made_totalintegerSeason total of free-throw makes ((Chinese text)).
ft_att_avgdoublePer-game average of free-throw attempts ((Chinese text)).
ft_att_totalintegerSeason total of free-throw attempts ((Chinese text)).
points_avgdoublePer-game average of points ((Chinese text)).
points_totalintegerSeason total of points ((Chinese text)).
reb_off_avgdoublePer-game average of offensive rebounds ((Chinese text)).
reb_off_totalintegerSeason total of offensive rebounds ((Chinese text)).
reb_def_avgdoublePer-game average of defensive rebounds ((Chinese text)).
reb_def_totalintegerSeason total of defensive rebounds ((Chinese text)).
reb_avgdoublePer-game average of total rebounds ((Chinese text)).
reb_totalintegerSeason total of total rebounds ((Chinese text)).
ast_avgdoublePer-game average of assists ((Chinese text)).
ast_totalintegerSeason total of assists ((Chinese text)).
stl_avgdoublePer-game average of steals ((Chinese text)).
stl_totalintegerSeason total of steals ((Chinese text)).
blk_avgdoublePer-game average of blocks ((Chinese text)).
blk_totalintegerSeason total of blocks ((Chinese text)).
tov_avgdoublePer-game average of turnovers ((Chinese text)).
tov_totalintegerSeason total of turnovers ((Chinese text)).
pf_avgdoublePer-game average of personal fouls ((Chinese text)).
pf_totalintegerSeason total of personal fouls ((Chinese text)).
fg2_pctdouble2-point percentage 0-100 ((Chinese text); the cell holds the same value as average and total).
fg3_pctdouble3-point percentage 0-100 ((Chinese text); same value as average and total).
ft_pctdoubleFree-throw percentage 0-100 ((Chinese text); same value as average and total).

Details

  • Unofficial use of a public source: these wrappers read pleagueofficial.com (P. LEAGUE+, Taiwan's men's league), keyless. The site's /user-policy (members' terms, section 11) reserves all content on the site to the service and its rights holders and forbids use, copying, adaptation or distribution without authorisation (it says nothing about automated access); robots.txt holds only Cloudflare content-signal comment lines with no Allow, Disallow or Crawl-delay rule. Use for reference only; payloads are not redistributed as release assets, and a data release needs owner sign-off. Requests are spaced at least 1 s apart per host, retries included.

  • Access: the site sits behind Cloudflare. sdv-py fetches it with curl_cffi (Chrome TLS); this R port sends a browser User-Agent through libcurl, which was served on a live check (2026-10-18); Cloudflare may still answer a request with an HTTP 403 challenge page (hoopR_asset_fetch). Redirects are not followed: the site answers an unknown gid or a season before 2020-21 with a 302 to the home page (hoopR_no_data).

  • Coverage: schedules, standings and player tables from 2020-21 (season = 2021); box scores for every finished game from 2020-21; play-by-play (with shot x / y) from 2022-23 (gid 191 on). 2020-21 and 2021-22 pages embed an empty game uuid, so they have no play-by-play and no Preciser data (hoopR_no_data). A game is keyed by gid: ONE global integer sequence over every stage and season. Only finished games are served: an unplayed game, or a box or play-by-play that does not match its game page (the routes echo no id, so the game page is fetched first, cached for the session, and the body's scores, quarters and points are checked against it), raises hoopR_asset_fetch.

  • Seasons are END years (2025 = the site's slug '2024-25'). Text is Traditional Chinese as printed (names, venues, play-by-play phrases); the column descriptions gloss it in English. Ids: team_id (1-8) is stable across renames; the box player_id is the player-team membership. The box random_id is UNRELIABLE before 2022-23 (gid 13 gives one player another player's page id): join box rows on player_id, and box rows to Preciser shots on person_id, never on random_id. The date of birth is dropped from the player frame; officials appear by name only.

  • Errors are classed conditions, all inheriting hoopR_error: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, a redirect, a stage the season does not have, a game with no play-by-play, a season before 2020-21), hoopR_bad_request (an invalid argument, HTTP 400 / 422) and hoopR_asset_fetch (any other non-200, a dead connection, an empty or unreadable body, a page for another game, season, stage or player, an unfinished game, layout drift, a play-by-play phrase outside the observed vocabulary). HTTP 429 / 502 / 503 / 504 are retried, up to three attempts; HTTP 500 is NOT retried (the site answers 500 for an unknown id). Wrappers raise; they never warn and return empty.

# \donttest{
